whatIs.title: What is Rock Paper Scissors?
whatIs.description: A universally known decision game. Supports 1v1, best-of-N, and tournament modes with stats and history tracking.

howToUse.title: How to Use
items: Select a mode (1v1 / Best of N / Tournament).
The result is shown with animation.
In tournament mode, register players and play matches.

tips.title: Tips
items: Use best-of mode to settle decisions fairly.
Tournament mode works great for group events.
Check your stats to analyze your patterns.

items.a: It's completely random. Previous results don't affect future choices.
